fusions.name: Rolling Glare
fusions.desc: Deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Glint Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a glint that deals 5 damage and sets the target [Marked] with a 35% chance for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Curled Watch
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Watch
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner. Your armour rises by 12%.
